deadline_semantics.no_receipt_stop: STOP is admitted from permit-result time through the effective deadline inclusive; later is invalid
deadline_semantics.no_receipt_timeout: TIMEOUT is exactly equal to the effective deadline
deadline_semantics.present_tail: adapter consumption, receipt, acknowledgement, terminal and result are all strictly less than the effective deadline
deadline_semantics.rule: effective deadline is min(lease_deadline_ms, permit_deadline_ms, watchdog_deadline_ms)

semantic_invariants: convergence_result exactly repeats the verified convergence request binding and is ALLOW
PREPARE is single, ordered before COMMIT, and carries no execution capability
COMMIT is single and is the sole authority-bearing stage
replay identity is the stable pair authority_epoch and durable_consumption_digest
lease, watchdog arm, permit and every tail record bind the originating permit
point-of-use permit is revalidated immediately before atomic consumption
failure and unknown require FAILURE_ACK then STOP/BLOCK
missing receipt requires STOP or exact-deadline TIMEOUT then bounded BLOCK
success requires signed receipt, ACK, HEALTHY and final ACK
